Trace, implement and test: LCP 79. 提取咒文

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    int extractMantra(vector<string>& matrix, string mantra) {
        int m = matrix.size(), n = matrix[0].size();
        int l = mantra.size();
        queue<tuple<int, int, int>> q;
        q.push({0, 0, 0});
        bool vis[m][n][l + 1];
        memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
        int dirs[5] = {-1, 0, 1, 0, -1};
        int ans = 0;
        for (; q.size(); ++ans) {
            for (int size = q.size(); size; --size) {
                auto [i, j, k] = q.front();
                q.pop();
                if (k == l) {
                    return ans;
                }
                if (matrix[i][j] == mantra[k] && !vis[i][j][k + 1]) {
                    vis[i][j][k + 1] = true;
                    q.push({i, j, k + 1});
                } else {
                    for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {
                        int x = i + dirs[c], y = j + dirs[c + 1];
                        if (x >= 0 && x < m && y >= 0 && y < n && !vis[x][y][k]) {
                            vis[x][y][k] = true;
                            q.push({x, y, k});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
};
